title: Master Carnatic & Hindustani Rāga Encyclopedia Database (1000+ Rāgas)
description: Exhaustive master rāga encyclopedia cataloging over 1,000+ Melakarta, Janya, Vakra, Upāṅga, Bhāṣāṅga, and Nishkrama rāgas, complete with scale definitions, parent mēḷa mappings, swarasthāna codes, emotional signatures, and historical treatise citations.

treatise_bibliography.citation: N. S. Ramachandran (1938), 'The Ragas of Karnatic Music', University of Madras.
Dr. Dhandapani & D. Pattammal (1984), 'Raga Pravaham' (Catalog of 5,000 Ragas).
